scope: Offline deterministic seed-zero full-workload calibration; the overtime latest-feasible-counter reaction is a changed workload policy, not prior GH/browser equivalence.

policy.baseline: frozen GH planner at each 300-tick decision boundary
policy.emergency: only in overtime with exactly one south lane tower remaining; forecast lethal damage from already-launched projectiles and alive north units currently targeting that tower, including observed attack cycles or projected deploy/approach/first-hit timing; choose an affordable layer-capable card only when its member-level estimated kill precedes the forecast deadline and waiting one 60-tick observation would make it too late; replace a coincident baseline command with this one command; skip if committed projectiles are independently lethal before the counter estimate
policy.placement: nearest legal own-side point to the selected current attacker position, using the existing deployment evaluator
stateAdaptiveInputs: number and HP of surviving south lane towers
observed active-cycle remaining ticks or projected deploy/approach/first-hit schedule
estimateLimits: future target schedules assume current tower target and attack cadence persist
projected movement and projectile travel use roster speed and estimated tower footprint
counter ETA assumes eligible members focus the selected threat and omits target approach/projectile travel
unknown body radii and attack retargeting remain outside the ETA

attempts.estimateBasis: card-wide eligible member damage; 6-tick deployment offsets only where this card carries the sourced interval receipt; own movement estimate omits target approach and projectile travel; assumes members focus the threat
